At the beginning of the game, you need to make the original syrup first by putting ingredients like butter, sugar, eggs,and lemon in a boiler and simmering them. Then you will select 1-6 of the 12 ingredients to juice as a flavoring for the syrup. If you are interested, come and enjoy it.
